card.name: First letter of split drug and disease names
card.fires_on: A single capital letter (G, B, P, L) that starts a drug, disease or person name which continues in the next piece, such as G-atifloxacin, P-DE5 or B-CG. It also fires on a word ending like -al in esophageal.

modes.label: Capital letter opening a drug or term
modes.description: A lone capital letter begins a drug name or abbreviation, often at the start of a sentence or heading.

modes.label: Capital letter opening a disease or name
modes.description: A lone capital letter begins a disease term or a person's first initial, and the rest follows.

card.plain: It lights up when a long medical name is broken up and only its first letter has been read so far.
